vapourPressure.source: Fitted to the Antoine equation of Dreyer, Martin, et al., 1955 (log10(P/bar) = 4.21948 - 1525.06/(T/K -56.379), 303.07-417.92 K, coefficients calculated by NIST from the authors' data; NIST Chemistry WebBook (SRD 69), https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C100425&Units=SI&Mask=4), sampled at 60 points, and to the ChemSep v8.3 critical point (636.00 K, 3840000 Pa): max deviation 0.100 % from the Antoine equation, +0.10 % at the critical point. Range 303.07-636.00 K: below 303.07 K there are no measured data in the WebBook; between 417.92 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the critical point. The ChemSep vapour-pressure equation was not used: it gives 417.14 K at 101.325 kPa against the measured 418.34 K, and it diverges above about 420 K (3.2e+08 Pa at the critical temperature, against the critical pressure 3.84e+06 Pa).

vapourPressure.source: Fitted to measured vapour pressures (NIST TRC ThermoML Archive): 148 values with stated uncertainties within 1 % from 8 articles, max deviation 0.96 %, and 34 values with larger stated uncertainties, kept where the fit is within them (they extend the range to 277.92 K); and the ChemSep v8.3 pure-component database critical point (545.50 K, 4830000 Pa). Between 535.03 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the critical point. The ChemSep vapour-pressure equation was not used: it deviates from the values within 1 % by +1.8 % (median, +5.3 % at most). Articles: Horstmann et al., J. Chem. Thermodyn. 36 (2004) 1015-1018, doi:10.1016/j.jct.2004.07.014; Safarov et al., J. Chem. Thermodyn. 47 (2012) 56-61, doi:10.1016/j.jct.2011.09.022; Antosik et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 49 (2004) 11-17, doi:10.1021/je025660t; Ewing and Ochoa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 49 (2004) 486-491, doi:10.1021/je034144f; Giles and Wilson, J. Chem. Eng. Data 51 (2006) 1954-1962, doi:10.1021/je050317k; Fang et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 58 (2013) 1483-1489, doi:10.1021/je3009792; Laavi et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 54 (2009) 613-618, doi:10.1021/je800535c; Zhu et al., Fluid Phase Equilib. 425 (2016) 289-296, doi:10.1016/j.fluid.2016.06.022; Prasad et al., J. Chem. Thermodyn. 39 (2007) 202-205, doi:10.1016/j.jct.2006.07.014; Prasad et al., J. Chem. Thermodyn. 39 (2007) 1458-1462, doi:10.1016/j.jct.2007.03.007; Xin et al., J. Chem.
